request.description:
AI-Doctor endpoint for patient consultations and general health queries.
Provides medical information, symptom analysis, and health advice.
Integrates with Flask backend AI service for intelligent responses.

Specialized AI chat endpoint for doctors and healthcare professionals.
Provides detailed medical information, drug interactions, treatment protocols,
clinical decision support, and professional medical guidance.
Requires doctor role authentication.

Retrieve all chat sessions for the authenticated user.
Sessions are ordered by last activity (most recent first).
Supports filtering by session type.

Retrieve a specific chat session with all messages.
Messages are ordered chronologically (oldest first).
Only the session owner can access the session.

Check the health status of the chatbot service and Flask backend connectivity.
Useful for monitoring and debugging the AI service integration.
